programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In this special episode, we take a closer look at cases previously featured on this series. Our goal is to explore more fully some of the investigative methods and techniques that have made the FBI the premier law enforcement agency in the world.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the United States faced a deadly new enemy abroad, an expanding network of terrorists targeting American interests. Hundreds of innocent people were killed in bombings, executions, and hijackings.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: Kalla mig Dave

programme.title: Modern Persuasion

programme.title: Storfräsarna

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren är tveksam om hon ska gå på Heidis bröllop efter det att Spencer äntligen bett om ursäkt. Brody vägrar att riskera vänskapen med Jayde för att rädda förhållandet med Audrina - och Stephanie konfronterar Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens sista avsnitt måste hon bestämma sig för om hon kan förlåta Spencer och stötta Heidi på hennes prinsessbröllop. Alla är där - och blir chockerade när en oväntad gäst dyker upp.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin startar krig när hon flörtar med Justin framför näsan på Audrina. Trots att de letar ny bostad tillsammans köper Spencer en utan att Heidi godkänt det.

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får känna på hur det är att vara i ett förhållande med Justin när han aldrig dyker upp på Brodys överraskningsfest. Heidi och Spencer är inte överens om när de ska skaffa barn, och Audrina går på dejt med Justins bäste vän.

programme.desc: The team searches for a geneticist's daughter who they suspect was abducted by her unstable mother but become more concerned when they think the young girl may be a clone. Also, Charlie and Amita talk about having kids and Liz reveals a dark secret.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When strange, almost paranormal happenings are observed at a decommissioned air base, the spooky occurrences take on a decidedly different tone when the team is brought in to investigate the mystery of a dead woman found there.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team conducts an undercover sting to locate a cyber crime lord, but the operation is foiled by a charming, brilliant hacker whose desire to take over the online black markets puts him in a dangerous online turf war that could lead to murder.

programme.desc: When robbers hit a diamond exchange and take hostages, Don and the team find an unlikely ally in convict John Buckley, who may help the team's investigation when they believe the men are copying Buckley's criminal strategies.

programme.desc: On September 17, 1984, in a suburb of Tucson, Arizona, eight-year-old Vicki Hoskins left home on her pink bicycle to mail a letter for her mother. She never returned, but her slightly damaged bicycle was found nearby.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: On a cold December night in 1993, Rose Larner stopped in a convenience store on her way to her boyfriend's house. She was never seen or heard from again. Rose's disappearance remained a mystery, until a tiny clue is found years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Killing Room
programme.desc: When Scott Dunn goes missing, police spray his bedroom with Luminol and uncover a scene of horrific violence. Now investigators face a daunting task: proving that Scott Dunn had been murdered without a body, a witness or a murder weapon.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Talking Skull
programme.desc: In 1987, a human skull and some bones were discovered at a Boy Scout Camp near Farmington, Missouri. Facial reconstruction aids the investigators in this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Beaten by a Hair
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Forensic scientists use evidence from her bedroom to direct police to a prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Without a Trace
programme.desc: After being admitted to the hospital with unexplained bleeding, 11-month-old Chad Shelton dies. Investigators and scientists frantically search for a cause when others from the same house fall ill.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Violated Me!
programme.desc: Monique wants to prove that Chris attacked her when he gave her a ride home after a party. But Chris denies any wrongdoing, and says Monique was too drunk to know what happened.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: She Said She'd Drown the Baby
programme.desc: Devon slipped into a coma and is on life support. But before he fell into a coma, he told his mother that his ex Alisha said he did not father their son. Alisha denies ever saying this and feels his whole family has turned their backs on her.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Cheaters Come Clean
programme.desc: Couples reveal they have been cheating on today's Jerry Springer Show. Candice confronts Nikki for sleeping with her man and Mike suspects Moon has been cheating with two people.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Holiday Hell Feast
programme.desc: Melody is horrified that her sister, Amanda, is ruining her life by dating a 54 year old biker and loser named Wolf. Today they'll face off against Amanda's entire family!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Homewreckers Confronted
programme.desc: Linda says her former best friend is trying to steal her man and she's fighting back! Then, Sherry wants her boyfriend Terry's wife Sandy and her family out of their lives!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Wives Battle Mistresses
programme.desc: Today, Vicki will face her husband Jason and his lover with an ultimatum and Anna admits she’s trying to steal Misty’s husband – again!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: .357 Magnum
programme.desc: The murder of a popular teen at a crowded house party sends Kenda down a winding road paved with lies, misdirection, and innuendo.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Who Took Heather?
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl is missing, sending Kenda’s city into a panic. A cryptic letter to the District Attorney’s office suggests the girl isn’t the only victim.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Knock Knock
programme.desc: A gathering of friends turns deadly when two gunmen shoot William Davis in the head. Kenda and his team dig into his past and start to suspect someone in William’s circle is lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Shot Through the Heart
programme.desc: 15yr old Chuck returns home from school to find his mother, Betty Limbrick, shot dead on the floor. Evidence points to a robbery gone wrong, but Kenda uncovers a plot almost too shocking to believe.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Weight
programme.desc: A seemingly random attack leaves Mary Moebus dead, and police flummoxed by a daunting field of suspects. But when Lt Joe Kenda uncovers a cache of new evidence, he realizes someone’s been lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Grip
programme.desc: When a speeding truck crashes into a residential building, officers find the lifeless body of Michael Faast behind the wheel. But he didn’t die in the wreck – he was shot point-blank in the temple.

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Family Torn Apart
programme.desc: The murdered body of Bob Dorotik, a engineer and father of three, was found by a mountain road near his home in the foothills of San Diego, Ca. Despite her denial of any involvement, Jane, Dorotik’s wife of 30 years, was arrested for the crime.

programme.title: 48 Hours: By Two and Two
programme.desc: An investigation into the real-life murder mystery that inspired true crime author Jim Schutze of Dallas, Texas to write By Two And Two.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: The investigation of the September 24, 1988 sexual torture-murder in Louisville, Kentucky, of Brenda Sue Schaefer.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Thomas Capano, a successful Delaware lawyer lived a double life, a devoted family man while having affairs. When Anne Marie Fahey, one of these women, mysteriously disappeared police were at first stumped. Finally evidence led to Capano.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Bitter Pill
programme.desc: Stella Nickell of Auburn, Washington, was sentenced to 90 year in federal prison for poisoning her husband Bruce and Sue Snow, a Seattle bank manager with cyanide-laced Excedrin.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: An infant and his two-year-old sister are found dead in a house shared by two families. At first, they are believed to have died from either carbon monoxide poisoning or cold medicine overdoses.

programme.title: iCarly: iTabbar 2: Electric Tabbaloo

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Formula

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Bond

programme.title: Forensic Files: Invisible Intruder
programme.desc: In 1996, police received a call from Darlie Routier telling them of her two sons' murders. The police found the killer by analyzing blood spatter, doing behavioral profiling and analyzing Darlie's 911 call.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ultimate Betrayal

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cement the Case

programme.title: Forensic Files: Innocence Lost

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: Corpus Christi
programme.desc: Daniel sitter på en ungdomsanstalt och har ett andligt uppvaknande. Hans kriminella förflutna hindrar honom från att bli präst men när han, efter frigivningen, drar en vit lögn blir han snabbt en spirituell ledare i en bygd. Sanningen får inte komma fram.

programme.title: I'm Not There
programme.desc: Bob Dylan gestaltas i denna film av vitt skilda skådespelare i en serie av sammanvävda historier. Resultatet är en vacker hyllning till Dylan och hans musik samt en inblick i en musikalisk enstörings liv, som både fans och nybörjare kan glädjas över.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The Man from Rome
programme.desc: En hackare tar sig in i Vatikanens säkerhetssystem och lämnar ett brådskande meddelande till påven. Fader Lorenzo Quart, en agent från Vatikanens underrättelsetjänst, skickas till Sevilla i Spanien för att utreda några mystiska dödsfall.

programme.title: Agent of Deceit
programme.desc: En ung kvinna blir överfallen i sitt eget hem. En av poliserna som ska skydda henne får henne att äntligen kunna slappna av, helt omedveten om att hon släppt in det verkliga hotet i sitt liv...

programme.title: Wild Mouse

programme.title: Vamps

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Chip är en vanlig enkel kille och hans Liza är en helt suverän flickvän.När hon föreslår att de ska sno en massa stålar från hennes sliskige välgörare börjar Chip se en sida av Liza som han inte visste fanns…

programme.title: Boomerang: Pilot

programme.title: Boomerang: Game Night
programme.desc: Bryson har spelkväll med gänget, men svartsjukan spirar när Simone får upp ögonen för en oväntad gäst. Dessutom träffas David och Crystal för första gången sen skilsmässan.

programme.title: Boomerang: Power

programme.title: Games People Play: Pilot

programme.title: Games People Play: Lover's Moon

programme.title: Games People Play: The Drink of Kings
programme.desc: Marcus och Vanessa går i parterapi. Nia och MJ försöker komma tillbaka efter förlusten av Laila-storyn. Laila börjar jobba på privata event för Roxanne och träffar Susie Q. Susie bjuder med Laila till ett stort gig.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mixed Messages
programme.desc: En insikt om Andre får Mary Jane att träffa en man på nätet. Samtidigt visar sig förändring vara för mycket för Mark, Helens diamantarmband försvinner; de verkliga känslorna för barnen Patterson kommer upp till ytan.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2608

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2709

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2904

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2802

programme.title: Melrose Place

programme.desc: Lexi gör Megan sällskap på en middag med Ryan och skakar om Amanda med sin affärsskicklighet. Under tiden försöker Ryan ta reda på vad Lexis planer är.

programme.desc: Efter en het sammandrabbning erkänner Michael sitt trohetstest för Jane, som då ger honom ett ultimatum: sluta spionera på henne annars ställs bröllopet in.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Episod 506

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 601

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 602

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
